description: Whether a wallet's new Mamo Account is deployed on Base yet. Use it after `create_account` answered `pending`: it lands a minute or two later. No signature; poll about every 15 seconds. Answers `ready` with the Account's address, `pending`, or `unknown` when Base could not be fully read. Pass `requestedAt` from `create_account` to learn when a wait is worth reporting.

address.description: The wallet the Account is being opened for, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

requestedAt.description: The `requestedAt` timestamp `create_account` returned, so a slow creation can be flagged.

name: get_account_creation_status
title: Check whether a new Mamo Account exists yet
